"""
Directs the executor to deliver this part of the result after the initial result.
"""
directive @defer(
  """
  If false, this field _won't_ be deferred.
  """
  if: Boolean = true

  """
  A unique label to identify the deferred payload.
  """
  label: String
) on FIELD | FRAGMENT_SPREAD | INLINE_FRAGMENT

"""
Autogenerated return type of AcceptTermsMutation.
"""
type AcceptTermsMutationPayload {
  """
  A unique identifier for the client performing the mutation.
  """
  clientMutationId: String
  currentUser: CurrentUser
  errors: [UserError!]!

  """
  Generate a JWT Token. null if, and only if, currentUser is null.
  """
  jwtToken(
    """
    Audience claim identifies the intended audience for this token. Consider
    using a value that uniquely identifies your use case.
    """
    aud: String!
  ): JwtToken
  result: String!
}

"""
The acceptor settlement info
"""
input AcceptorSettlementInfoInput {
  additionalPaymentInfo: AdditionalPaymentInfoInput
  conversionCreditIds: [ID!]
  creditCardType: CreditCardType
  currency: SupportedCurrency!
  exchangeRateId: String!
  paymentMethod: TokenPaymentMethod!
  platform: Platform
  returnUrl: String
  savePaymentMethod: Boolean = false
  useAvailableCredits: Boolean = false
  walletChallengeSignature: StarkwareSignatureInput
}

"""
An Account
"""
type Account implements Node {
  accountable: Accountable!
  id: ID!
  owner: AccountOwner
  sorareManaged: Boolean!
}

"""
Object that can be an account owner
"""
union AccountOwner = Contract | User

"""
Object that can be an account accountable
"""
union Accountable = CommonAccount | EthereumAccount | FiatWalletAccount | LoomAccount | SolanaAccount | StarkwareAccount

"""
An activity a manager shared with their followers
"""
interface ActivityFeedInterface {
  backgroundUrl: String

  """
  The most recent reaction the current user left on this activity
  """
  currentUserReaction: ActivityReaction @deprecated(reason: "Use currentUserReactions instead")

  """
  The reactions the current user left on this activity, the oldest first
  """
  currentUserReactions: [ActivityReaction!]!
  gameMode: PlatformGameMode!
  id: ID!

  """
  The reactions left on this activity, the most recent first The `reactions` field cannot be nested within a list.
  """
  reactions(
    """
    Returns the elements in the list that come after the specified cursor.
    """
    after: String

    """
    Returns the elements in the list that come before the specified cursor.
    """
    before: String

    """
    Only return the reactions left with this emoji
    """
    emoji: String

    """
    Returns the first _n_ elements from the list.
    """
    first: Int

    """
    Returns the last _n_ elements from the list.
    """
    last: Int

    """
    Filter the reactions on the nickname of the manager who left them
    """
    search: String
  ): ActivityReactionConnection!

  """
  How many managers left each emoji, in the order the emojis were first used
  """
  reactionsCount: [ActivityReactionCount!]!
  sharedAt: ISO8601DateTime!
  user: User!
}

"""
The connection type for ActivityFeedInterface.
"""
type ActivityFeedInterfaceConnection {
  """
  A list of edges.
  """
  edges: [ActivityFeedInterfaceEdge!]!

  """
  A list of nodes.
  """
  nodes: [ActivityFeedInterface!]!

  """
  Information to aid in pagination.
  """
  pageInfo: PageInfo!
}

"""
An edge in a connection.
"""
type ActivityFeedInterfaceEdge {
  """
  A cursor for use in pagination.
  """
  cursor: String!

  """
  The item at the end of the edge.
  """
  node: ActivityFeedInterface
}

"""
The reaction a manager left on an activity
"""
type ActivityReaction implements Node {
  """
  The activity this reaction was left on
  """
  activity: ActivityFeedInterface!
  emoji: String!
  id: ID!
  reactedAt: ISO8601DateTime!
  user: User!
}

"""
